itemdroptweaks.title: Item Drop Tweaks
itemdroptweaks.option.mod_enabled.desc: Toggles the mod on or off. Dropped items then look exactly like vanilla.
itemdroptweaks.option.copies_by_count.de: Vanilla draws at most 5 copies of an item and stops growing the pile at 48. This derives the number of copies from the real stack size instead, so a merged stack of 2000 looks bigger than one of 50.
itemdroptweaks.option.max_copies.desc: Upper limit for the number of copies drawn. Vanilla caps at 5. Each copy is another draw call, so keep it moderate if many stacks lie around.
itemdroptweaks.option.scale_by_count.des: Make larger stacks physically bigger on top of drawing more copies.
itemdroptweaks.option.scale_max.desc: How much bigger the largest stack gets. 1.5 means half again as large at Max Stack Size.
itemdroptweaks.option.count_max.desc: The stack size that counts as the top of the scale. Without an item-merging mod a drop never exceeds one full stack, so raise this only if you use one. The scale is logarithmic.
itemdroptweaks.option.render_drops.desc: Draw dropped items at all. Turning this off hides them completely, shadow included.
itemdroptweaks.option.glow.desc: Minimum light level the item is drawn at, so it stays visible in the dark. 0 is vanilla. It only ever brightens, never darkens.
itemdroptweaks.option.scale.desc: Size of the dropped item. 1.0 is the vanilla size.
itemdroptweaks.option.scale_shadow.desc: Scale the shadow along with the item. Off keeps the vanilla shadow size.
itemdroptweaks.option.spin_speed.desc: How fast dropped items rotate. 1.0 is vanilla, 0 stops them (every item then faces the same way).
itemdroptweaks.option.bob_speed.desc: How fast items float up and down. 1.0 is vanilla, 0 freezes the motion — each item then rests at its own height.
itemdroptweaks.option.bob_height.desc: How far items travel while floating. 1.0 is vanilla, 0 holds them steady.
itemdroptweaks.option.spread.desc: How far apart the copies in a pile sit. 1.0 is vanilla, 0 stacks them in the same spot.
